lessons.correction: Continue strengthening your ground army and increase production. Maintain your defensive posture while preparing for a potential engagement.
lessons.mistake: Engaging head-on into a well-positioned Siege Tank line without proper support or a plan to break it.
lessons.recheck: Re-evaluate when you have a clear army advantage or if the opponent switches to a more air-heavy composition.
lessons.title: Avoid head-on engagement against Siege Tank lines
lessons.when: Midgame, around 9 minutes, with a heavy ground army and heavy tech. Opponent has a strong ground army with Siege Tanks and Medivacs.
lessons.why: Your ground army is well-suited to counter the Terran's composition. Dark Templars can be effective against Siege Tanks if positioned well.

lessons.correction: Maintain your defensive posture while increasing your production and tech. Continue to expand to support your growing army.
lessons.mistake: Over-extending with expansions or tech that leaves you vulnerable to early pressure.
lessons.recheck: Re-evaluate when you have scouted the opponent's tech path or if they attempt a timing attack.
lessons.title: Avoid over-extending with expansions or tech
lessons.when: Early-midgame, around 5-6 minutes, with heavy production and tech. Opponent shows a ground posture with Marines and Reapers.
lessons.why: A strong economy and tech advantage will allow you to outproduce the opponent in the mid-game. Your defensive structures buy you time.

lessons.correction: Continue to invest in technology while maintaining a defensive posture. Keep your options open for either a ground or air transition.
lessons.mistake: Over-committing to expansions or air units before confirming the opponent's intentions, leaving you exposed to early aggression.
lessons.recheck: Re-evaluate when you have more information about the opponent's army or if they apply pressure.
lessons.title: Avoid over-committing to expansions or air units
lessons.when: Early-midgame, around 4-5 minutes, with heavy tech investment and moderate production. Opponent shows a ground posture with Reapers.
lessons.why: Heavy tech investment gives you flexibility to counter the opponent's eventual composition. A defensive posture prevents early game losses.
